---
title: "Gradient Descent Method"
author: "Jimmy Zheng"
date: "2023-03-28"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Define a loss function (example: quadratic loss)
loss_function <- function(x) (x - 2)^2

# Define the gradient of the loss function
loss_gradient <- function(x) 2 * (x - 2)

# Initial model value
F_m1 <- 0

# Learning rate
nu <- 0.5

# Update the model
F_m <- F_m1 - nu * loss_gradient(F_m1)

# Create data for plotting the loss function
x_vals <- seq(-2, 4, 0.1)
y_vals <- loss_function(x_vals)

# Create data for plotting the tangent line
tangent_x <- seq(F_m1 - 1, F_m1 + 1, 0.1)
tangent_y <- loss_function(F_m1) + loss_gradient(F_m1) * (tangent_x - F_m1)

# Create the plot
ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, color = "Loss Function")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = tangent_x, y = tangent_y, color = "Tangent Line")) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = F_m1, yend = loss_function(F_m1), color = "Initial Model Vector"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = F_m, yend = loss_function(F_m), color = "Updated Model Vector"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = F_m1, y = loss_function(F_m1), xend = F_m, yend = loss_function(F_m), color = "Negative Gradient Vector"), linetype = "dashed", arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"))) +
  geom_point(aes(x = F_m1, y = loss_function(F_m1), color = "Initial Model"), size = 4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = F_m, y = loss_function(F_m), color = "Updated Model"), size = 4) +
  labs(x = "F(x)", y = "L(y, F(x))") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Loss Function" = "blue", "Tangent Line" = "red", "Initial Model Vector" = "darkgreen", "Updated Model Vector" = "black", "Negative Gradient Vector" = "orange", "Initial Model" = "green", "Updated Model" = "purple")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Negative Gradient Vector on the Loss Function Plot") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```
